jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**This is a full-time, in-office position requiring the employee to work on-site at their assigned PeopleSpace office location.**

The Project Coordinator is responsible for sales support and the entire sales order fulfillment process, including management from order entry point through installation. This full-time position provides support for Sales, Project Management, Strategic Accounts Team, along with accurate and timely customer service. Coordinates order entry, order management, factory interface and closeout of orders

Responsibilities:

Customer Service

* Communicates with internal team regarding order status
* Provides clarification and answers for questions regarding order issues

Order Preparation

* Assists sales with preparation of the quotation
* Reviews and proofs order for basic information (i.e. ship to, bill to, contract number, etc.), accuracy and completeness
* Processes orders into our internal system and transmits orders to manufacturers electronically including invoicing and collections (sending email follow-up)

Sales Order Management

* Disperses order information to appropriate internal and external personnel (sales staff, operations, customer, etc.)
* Checks acknowledgments against order; resolves discrepancies with factory; tracks shipments and shortages.
* Reviews receiving information from field operation and matches to order; resolves discrepancies before approval and sending to payables

Work Order Management

* Prepares installation packages for the Service division
* Tracks any short shipped or missing items

File Control

* Manages master sales order and work order files, ensuring they are complete and up-to-date

Sales / Work Order Close-Out

* Maintains and files customer sign-offs for all assigned sales/work orders

Qualifications:

* Demonstrated proficiency in order entry, tracking, and scheduling
* Prior experience within the furniture industry is preferred
* Consistently reliable, efficient, and attentive to detail
* Exceptional communication skills coupled with a strong commitment to customer service

**Summary**
-----------

Corrections professionals who foster a humane and secure environment and ensure public safety by preparing individuals for successful reentry into our communities.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**

Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.

### **Clarification from the agency**

• BOP Employees nationwide. • DOJ Surplus and Displaced (CTAP) Employees in the local commuting area. • Duty Location: MDC Los Angeles, CA

  

**Duties**
----------

Under the general direction of the Warden, works with the Associate Warden(s) and department heads in developing plans, policies and programs for institution management.
  
  
Monitors and evaluates institution programs in terms of achievement of overall objectives.
  
  
Generates a variety of institutional reports, positions, papers, responses to congressional inquiries and general correspondence for the Warden.
  
  
Works with department heads to broaden ability to deal with institutional problems relating to financial management, manpower and plant resources.
  
  
Serves as Public Information Officer for the institution.
  
  
Represents the institution in dealing with community agencies and resources.
  
  
Coordinates meetings and conferences involving agency personnel, governmental executives, and the judiciary.
  
  
Along with all other correctional institution employees, incumbent is charged with responsibility for maintaining security of the institution.
  
  
The staff's correctional responsibilities precede all others required by this position and are performed on a regular and recurring basis.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

**Career Transition Programs (CTAP)**: This program applies to Federal and/or DOJ employees who meet the definition of surplus or displaced from a position in the competitive service. To receive selection priority for this position, you must:

* Meet CTAP eligibility criteria;

* Be rated well-qualified for the position, scoring at least half of the total possible points for the vacancy KSAs or competencies; and

* Submit the appropriate documentation to support your CTAP eligibility:
  + A copy of the agency notice (i.e., separation notice or agency RIF letter),
  + Most recent performance appraisal, and
  + Most recent SF-50 showing current/former position, grade, promotion potential, and duty location.

* U.S. Citizenship is Required.
* See Special Conditions of Employment Section.

### **Qualifications**

To be considered for the position, you must meet the following qualification requirements:
  
  
**Education:**
  
  
There is no substitution of education for specialized experience for this position.
  
  
**Experience:**
  
  
You must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent in difficulty and complexity to the next lower grade level. Specialized experience is directly related experience that included substantial involvement with a correctional program and provided a thorough knowledge of correctional techniques, or experience in meeting and dealing with people that demonstrated the ability to work effectively with inmates and associates in a correctional environment.
  
  
Experience must have also demonstrated the ability to perform supervisory or administrative duties successfully. jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Summary
  
Verbum Dei Jesuit High School seeks a creative, organized Marketing and Communications Coordinator to share the school’s story, strengthen its visibility, and engage students, families, alumni, donors, corporate partners, and prospective families.

Reporting to the Vice President of Mission Advancement, the Coordinator maintains the school’s brand and coordinates marketing and communications across digital and print platforms. This role works closely with Mission Advancement, Admissions, Athletics, and the Corporate Work Study Program to deliver timely, engaging communications that reflect Verbum Dei’s Catholic, Jesuit mission.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain consistent branding and design print and digital materials, including brochures, invitations, presentations, signage, and advertisements.
* Manage social media platforms, develop content calendars, create photo and video content, and execute campaigns to increase awareness and engagement.
* Write, edit, and coordinate newsletters, email campaigns, press releases, announcements, and other school communications; support annual reports, impact reports, and institutional publications.
* Maintain an editorial calendar, gather content across departments, and coordinate publication schedules to ensure accuracy and timely delivery.
* Manage Mailchimp or comparable email platforms, including formatting, audience segmentation, distribution, and performance tracking.
* Update website content and digital displays, coordinate photography and videography, maintain organized digital assets, and support media relations.
* Develop campaigns, marketing materials, and impact stories supporting fundraising, student recruitment, and corporate partnerships.
* Promote school events, coordinate related media coverage and vendors, track marketing performance, and perform other related duties as assigned.

This full-time, 12-month position is based on campus. Occasional evening and weekend hours are required for school events, athletics, fundraising, and community engagement. Some off-campus work may be required for corporate partner visits, media coverage, and special events.

Benefits include health insurance, retirement benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities, consistent with school policies.

How to Apply:
  
Interested candidates should submit a resume, cover letter, and portfolio or relevant work samples demonstrating skills in writing, graphic design, photography, video production, and social media content creation.

Please email application materials to:
  
Stephanie Andrade, Vice President of Mission Advancement
  
sandrade@verbjesuit.org

**Requirements**
----------------

* At least 2–3 years of professional experience in marketing, communications, digital media, graphic design, or related work; education or nonprofit experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, graphic design, digital media, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills, supported by a portfolio of relevant work.
* Graphic design proficiency using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or comparable tools; experience with photography, video editing, and short-form content creation.
* Experience managing social media and creating original digital content, with knowledge of digital marketing and audience engagement practices.
* Experience with website content management systems and email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp; Finalsite familiarity is a plus.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and project coordination skills, with the ability to take initiative and manage multiple deadlines independently.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with students, families, faculty, staff, alumni, donors, and corporate partners while maintaining brand standards.
* Creativity, dependability, flexibility, and a commitment to education and Verbum Dei’s Catholic, Jesuit mission.

Wage Range
  
*The rate of pay offered to the selected candidate is based on internal pay policy and budget. New hires are commonly paid at the minimum of the wage range or within the lower part of the range. We consider a number of factors when making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience, training and other department needs.*

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Flex Learning**

Flex Learning, LLC is a growing behavioral health organization providing individualized Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and behavioral support services to children, adolescents, and adults throughout the Los Angeles area.

We are committed to delivering compassionate, high-quality services while fostering a collaborative and supportive environment for our employees.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented entry level **Operations Coordinator** to support our administrative operations, human resources functions, employee engagement, and organizational development.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys working with people, managing multiple responsibilities, improving processes, and contributing to a growing healthcare organization.

This position works closely with the Owner/Clinical Director and Administrative Assistant and serves as an important resource for employees, applicants, and the community.

Key Responsibilities

**Human Resources & Employee Support**

* Coordinate recruitment activities, including job postings, applicant communication, and interview scheduling.
* Facilitate new-hire onboarding, orientation, and administrative training.
* Maintain accurate employee records, compliance documentation, and training trackers.
* Conduct routine employee check-ins and assist with employee engagement initiatives.
* Support performance review coordination and staff development activities.
* Assist with administrative aspects of scheduling, attendance, and workforce management.

**Operations & Quality Assurance**

* Monitor administrative workflows, deadlines, and assigned operational tasks.
* Conduct administrative quality assurance reviews to support compliance with company procedures.
* Track employee credentials, certifications, and required training.
* Identify operational challenges and recommend improvements.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of organizational policies and procedures.
* Provide administrative support to Behavior Technicians and clinical team members.
* Prepare daily task summaries and updates for management.

**Administrative Coordination**

* Coordinate internal meetings, training sessions, interviews, and organizational events.
* Maintain administrative calendars, documents, and operational trackers.
* Assist with office organization, inventory, equipment, and storage management.
* Support special projects and other administrative responsibilities as assigned.

**Recruitment & Community Outreach**

* Participate in job fairs, resource fairs, and recruitment events.
* Assist with employee engagement and internal communication initiatives.
* Represent Flex Learning professionally when interacting with applicants, employees, and community partners.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required:**

* Must be at least 18 years of age.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources or a related field
* Strong organizational, time-management, and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to work independently and proactively resolve routine operational challenges.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain confidential information.
* Ability to work the established schedule and attend required in-person activities, with reasonable accommodations as applicable.
* Bilingual Spanish speaking

**Preferred:**

* Experience in human resources, administrative coordination, office management, or recruitment.
* Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, or Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA).
* Familiarity with onboarding, employee compliance, and HR management systems.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, subject to eligibility and plan terms.
* Employer-paid life insurance.
* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Paid vacation and sick leave.
* Company-provided laptop and phone.
* Access to Wellness related resources (Calm App and Employee Assistance Program)
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Mileage reimbursement from office to other sites & vice versa.

***Work Schedule & Location***

This is a full-time, hourly position with a regular schedule of Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM, including a 60-minute unpaid meal period.

The position is **primarily** in-person attendance at our Downey administrative office and occasional community events or other authorized work locations with **some remote day** opportunities.

Occasional Saturday assignments ***will*** be required for operational activities (i.e., attendance at a job or community resource fair)

All hours worked, including applicable overtime, will be compensated in accordance with California law. Necessary business expenses will be reimbursed as required by law.

***Why Join Flex Learning?***

At Flex Learning, we believe that strong administrative operations are essential to delivering quality behavioral health services. Our Operations Coordinator plays an important role in supporting employees, improving internal systems, and helping our organization operate efficiently.

We value individuals who demonstrate initiative, professionalism, accountability, and a genuine interest in supporting others.

If you enjoy creating structure, solving problems, and contributing to a mission-driven organization, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Indirect Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Radiant**
-----------------

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based company building the world's only mass-produced, transportable nuclear microreactors. The U.S. grid is under growing strain, with power demand accelerating, driving higher utility costs, rising carbon emissions, and interconnection backlogs. Radiant has a solution, transportable, on-site power. Our first reactor, Kaleidos, is 1 megawatt: small enough to be factory-built, transported by land, sea, or air, and deployed wherever power is needed. 1 MW can power 1000 homes for five years. Ship it back and we refuel for a 20 year operating life. We made energy a product that can be used for critical infrastructure like military bases, data centers, hospitals, and remote sites, as well as the commercial main street businesses that keep America running. Founded in 2020, Radiant is under contract to deliver power to the U.S. Army, Navy and Air Force and has signed pre-order agreements with Equinix, with deployments beginning in 2028.

**About the Role**
------------------

Radiant is looking for an Indirect Procurement Associate to support sourcing and procurement of indirect goods and services — Facilities, IT, Professional Services, MRO, consumables, and R&D collaborations. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong technical instincts who wants to build skills in supplier evaluation, negotiation, and contract support. You'll work alongside Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Production, and will be paired with more senior procurement staff to develop your commercial and negotiation skill set.

**Responsibilities & Duties**

* Support sourcing efforts for indirect categories (IT, Professional Services, MRO, consumables, R&D collaborations) by gathering technical requirements and evaluating supplier capability against Radiant's engineering needs.
* Assist with drafting and reviewing SOWs, NDAs, and PO terms; help prepare negotiation positions for MSAs and licensing agreements under guidance from senior staff.
* Help manage facilities/MRO procurement tasks — coordinating with vendors on maintenance, repairs, equipment, and small lab build-out needs.
* Track purchase orders through the procure-to-pay cycle, flagging delays or technical mismatches early.
* Act as a day-to-day point of contact for select, lower-complexity suppliers, escalating high-stakes commercial matters to senior procurement staff.
* Contribute technical judgment to cost and quality trade-off discussions.
* Help identify supply chain risks from an engineering/technical perspective (e.g., part obsolescence, service quality issues).
* Support process documentation and improvement efforts.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related engineering field) strongly preferred, Supply Chain or similar degrees considered
* 1–3 years of relevant experience; prior procurement/sourcing experience is a plus but not required.
* Strong technical/mechanical aptitude and genuine interest in the commercial side of engineering (supplier selection, cost trade-offs, contracts).
* Good analytical and organizational skills; comfortable learning negotiation and contract fundamentals on the job.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable with ERP/MRP systems and standard office software (or willing to learn quickly).
* Occasional travel to supplier locations (up to 20%).

**Desired Qualifications**

* Exposure to Facilities, MRO, IT, or Professional Services sourcing.
* Coursework or interest in quality systems (ISO 9001, AS9100).
* Interest in the energy/nuclear sector.

**Additional Requirements**

* Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.
* Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.
* Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.
* One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.
* Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.
* Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.
* Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.
* 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.
* Nuclear Engineering Certificate Program: 100% covered educational program with Penn State University, for eligible employees, to rapidly upscale into nuclear.
* Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.
* Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.
* Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.
* Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

**Total Compensation and Benefits**  
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s full-time new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

We’re Sonesta International Hotels—the 8th largest hotel company in the U.S. (and growing fast ).

  

With a dynamic mix of full-service and focused hotels across major cities, our diverse portfolio of owned, managed, and franchised properties means we’re everywhere our guests need us to be.

But here’s the thing—we’re not just in the business of hotels, we’re in the business of people. We bring service with passion, loyalty with purpose, and create experiences that genuinely connect—delivering quality, value, and memorable stays across 1,000+ properties in eight countries (and counting).

  
  

**What this role is all about**

  
At Sonesta, our Sales & Marketing teams help bring the brand to life — building relationships, driving revenue, and creating excitement around our hotels, restaurants, meetings, and guest experiences. As the Sales & Marketing Coordinator, you’ll support the day-to-day coordination of sales, marketing, events, and commercial activities that help keep the hotel connected, visible, and growing.
  
  
This role is perfect for someone who’s organized, creative, detail-oriented, and excited to grow their career in hospitality sales and marketing. You’ll support client communication, marketing initiatives, social content, reporting, events, sales coordination, and administrative operations across the commercial team.
  
  
If you’re energetic, collaborative, and passionate about hospitality, branding, and relationship-building — we’d love to meet you.  
  
  

**What you’ll be doing**

* Support daily sales and marketing operations including administrative coordination, client communication, reporting, and event support.

* Assist with business transient, group, catering, and corporate sales activities including proposals, contracts, site tours, and lead management.

* Coordinate marketing initiatives, promotional campaigns, social media support, email marketing, and hotel collateral updates.

* Maintain CRM systems, account records, sales activity tracking, pipeline updates, and revenue reporting accurately and efficiently.

* Support the planning and execution of hotel events, networking opportunities, client meetings, trade shows, and community partnerships.

* Assist with creating presentations, sales materials, marketing content, and client-facing communications aligned with brand standards.

* Partner closely with Revenue Management, Catering, Operations, and hotel leadership teams to support commercial initiatives and guest experiences.

* Monitor online listings, hotel promotions, local marketing opportunities, and brand visibility efforts.

* Respond to client inquiries, coordinate follow-up communication, and help support exceptional customer service throughout the sales process.

* Help foster a collaborative, energetic, and guest-focused culture aligned with Sonesta’s People People philosophy.

* Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

* Experience using Microsoft Office, CRM systems, social media platforms, and marketing tools preferred.

Description:

Total Warehouse is seeking a highly analytical Sales Operations Administrator to strengthen the connection between Sales activity, customer intelligence, data quality, and operational execution.

This is not a traditional administrative or data-entry position. The role combines Sales Operations, CRM/ERP administration, KPI analysis, process auditing, commercial intelligence, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will evaluate whether work was completed correctly, determine what the information tells us, identify missing information and root causes, connect customer intelligence to business opportunities, drive corrective action, and help prevent recurring defects.

The position functions as the front-end quality and analytical layer in the Sales ? Sales Admin ? Sales Support/Execution ? Operations ? Customer Follow-Up operating model.

### **Core Responsibilities**

**Sales KPI and Data Analysis**

* Analyze Sales KPIs beyond activity counts to determine quality, accuracy, commercial value, and conversion.
* Review customer assets created, site visits, opportunities, quotes, follow-up activity, pipeline movement, account activity, and expected-close dates.
* Identify trends, outliers, exceptions, recurring defects, and missing information.
* Provide concise, exception-based reporting to Sales Leadership.
* Move measures from activity and count to quality, insight, and commercial outcomes.

**Customer Asset and Account Intelligence**

* Audit customer asset information, including make/model, serial number, location, application, condition, age/hours when available, power requirements, provider, lease/rental status, and service history.

**NetSuite/CRM Data Integrity**

* Identify incomplete, duplicate, stale, or incorrectly structured records.
* Route deficiencies to the appropriate owner with a required correction and due date.
* Re-audit completion and escalate repeated or material exceptions.

**Opportunity, Pipeline, and Quote Quality**

* Audit opportunities for customer challenge, application, solution, value, stage, timing, decision process, risks, next action, and follow-up date.
* Differentiate pipeline volume from qualified pipeline quality.
* Review quotes for the correct account, application, product/equipment, configuration, specifications, pricing basis, assumptions, support documentation, customer-value explanation, and follow-up plan.
* Validate critical information before work moves to downstream Operational Sales Support.

**Site Visit and Customer Intelligence**

* Ensure each site visit produces useful customer intelligence and commercial follow-through, not just completion of an activity KPI.

**Continuous Improvement and Root-Cause Analysis**

* Apply practical Lean/DMAIC thinking: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, and Control.
* Categorize recurring defects across training/knowledge, process, system/tool, data quality, and ownership/accountability.
* Help convert recurring problems into improved SOPs, training, workflows, controls, and system improvements.

* ERP/CRM experience required; NetSuite experience is strongly preferred.
* Ability to analyze datasets, identify patterns, and distinguish material exceptions from routine noise.
* Strong and concise written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide professional pushback when information is incomplete or unsupported.
* Strong organization, prioritization, and evidence-based follow-through.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of Lean, DMAIC, or structured continuous-improvement methods.
* Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Belt preferred.
* Experience with NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Excel, CRM reporting, and KPI/dashboard development.
* Experience in material handling, industrial equipment, distribution, logistics, warehousing, or B2B equipment sales/service.
* Commercial familiarity with equipment, Rental, Service, Parts, batteries/chargers, telematics, Allied/racking, or automation.

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator, based in Los Angeles, to keep our market running every day. You will keep driver shifts covered, vehicles assigned and ready, and the team working from the same information. When something breaks at 6 a.m., you are the person who already knows and is fixing it.

This is an on-site, hands-on role for someone who likes a fast pace, thinks in systems and enjoys being the person everyone relies on. You will work closely with Los Angeles market leadership and help build the processes and reporting the team uses as the market grows. Strong coordinators here grow into analyst and operations management roles.

SCHEDULE

Full-time, salaried, on-site in Los Angeles. This role supports a 24/7 operation, so some early mornings, evenings or weekends are expected.

* Run the Numbers: Track daily metrics such as coverage, utilization, attendance and vehicle status, and turn them into clear updates for leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

* 2+ years in operations, dispatch, logistics, fleet, transportation or another fast-moving operations environment.

* Comfort with data. You are strong in Google Sheets or Excel and like using numbers to make decisions.
* Clear, calm communication with drivers, teammates and leadership, especially when things go sideways.
* Flexibility to support a 24/7 operation, including some early mornings, evenings or weekends.

NICE TO HAVE

* Experience in rideshare, delivery, rental car or fleet operations.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator (Starshield)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**PRODUCTION COORDINATOR (STARSHIELD)**

Starshield leverages SpaceX's Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on three areas: Earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. Designed to meet diverse mission requirements, Starshield satellites are capable of integrating a wide variety of payloads, offering unique versatility to users. With the proven ability to iterate rapidly, SpaceX's unique full-stack approach in developing end-to-end systems, from launch vehicles to user terminals, enables the deployment of capabilities at scale with unprecedented speed. Starshield's proliferated low-Earth orbit architecture provides inherent resiliency and constant connectivity to on-orbit assets, while SpaceX's proven rapid launch capability provides expedient and economical access to space.

The Production Coordinator is a linchpin position within our Starshield team. This role serves as a liaison between input and output organizations to ensure that components and assemblies flow smoothly through the production area and meet stringent deadlines and quality standards.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Monitor, track, and move parts as required through the production flow to ensure timely delivery to the next production location
* Coordinate the physical movement of parts through receiving inspection, stockrooms, purchasing, production resources, or any applicable work center within SpaceX
* Ensure parts are handled and protected properly and within SpaceX specifications
* Coordinate off-site processing of parts to ensure on-time delivery as required
* Work with the planning, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure MRP/ERP data stays clean and accurate
* Assist with the resolution of incorrect system data that is driving inappropriate demand or schedules, or that could result in a general failure
* Analyze available data and develop metrics as required to drive optimal results
* Work with production personnel to ensure metric goals are understood
* Update and use the target management system to drive results as applicable
* Work with production supervisors and managers to ensure all metrics-driven action requirements are completed
* Develop and maintain reports to highlight needs, deliverables, and constraints as required for internal and customer use
* Communicate part status and estimated completion dates to leadership weekly
* Assist production leadership and project teams with action item updates as required
* Support the logistics process through the innovative staging of workflow as required
* Manage material certifications as required, and prevent the use of uncertified materials
* Support production and inventory personnel with return-to-stock and inventory purge actions
* Support purchase requisition creation for scheduled contract work as required
* Organize and maintain the physical and electronic library for production-related tooling and the calibration database as required
* Support projects or productivity development activities within assigned production cells
* Support assigned production cells with work order management activities as required

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalency certificate
* 1+ years of experience supporting administrative processes

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong computer skills and familiarity with the full Microsoft Office suite
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience organizing files and documents
* Knowledge of MRP/ERP systems
* Experience in aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or electronics manufacturing environments
* SQL and Tableau experience
* APICS certification

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be willing to work all shifts, overtime, and/or weekends as needed. Estimated 1st shift hours: 5:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m.
* Able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted
* Able to stand for extended periods, 8 hours minimum

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**  
  
Pay Range:  
Level 1: $22.00 - $24.50  
Level 2: $24.00 - $27.50  
Level 3: $27.00 - $31.00

  

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

The Social Media Temp will create brand awareness, demand for Roland DG products and customer engagement through social media channels. This position works closely within Marketing and with other departments to plan and deliver our content and brand presence through Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter and other leading platforms, as determined. The Social Media Temp will play equal parts as a producer of content – posting copy, video content and graphics – and manager of the overall social media strategy, calendar, analytics and campaigns. Roland DGA Corporation serves North and South America as the sales, marketing, distribution and service arm for Roland DG Corporation of Hamamatsu, Japan. Roland DG is a worldwide leader in wide-format inkjet printers for the sign, textile and personalization markets; engravers for awards, giftware, signage and direct part marking; and desktop 3D printers and milling machines for the dental CAD/CAM, product prototyping and medical industries.

Excellent knowledge of leading social media platforms and best practices, including Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, Tiktok and YouTube.

Experience and understanding of a variety of social media engagement and awareness strategies.

jobs.description:
The Auction Transaction Coordinator supports the accurate and timely processing of real estate auction transactions. This role manages the deal lifecycle from pre-listing through closing, including document preparation, escrow coordination, CRM data management, and pipeline administration. The position reports to the Director of Operations, Auction Services and works closely with the auction team, advisors, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless deal execution.  
  
The base hourly range for this role is $30.00 – $36.02 per hour. Actual pay will be determined by factors such as education, experience, and job-related skills relevant to the role. Marcus & Millichap is a multi-state employer and posted salary ranges are provided in good faith for compliance with all relevant pay-transparency regulations. These ranges may not reflect potential compensation for positions based in other states or regions.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Transaction & Document Management**

* Manage the full auction deal lifecycle from pre-listing through closing, utilizing Salesforce and Marcus & Millichap's internal transaction platform MNET
* Own, organize, and maintain each individual transaction deal folder, including legal documents, reports, photos, and marketing materials
* Prepare and onboard internal listing documents in compliance with company and state guidelines
* Prepare, send, and track agreement documents through DocuSign
* Track critical transaction dates and ensure all parties meet contractual deadlines
* Collect, organize, and maintain due diligence materials
* Coordinate legal agreements with Marcus & Millichap advisors/agents ensuring compliance across multiple jurisdictions
* Troubleshoot and resolve transactional issues throughout the deal process

**Escrow & Closing**

* Initiate title and escrow orders; track commitments and coordinate with title companies
* Coordinate with auction platforms to receive and process purchase agreements
* Manage post-auction escrow workflows, including wiring instructions and earnest money tracking
* Monitor escrow timelines and transaction records
* Process commission demands
* Submit final closing packages internally with all required documentation

**CRM & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate CRM records including contacts, properties, opportunities, and key deal dates
* Manage the MNET Pipeline and ensure transaction data integrity throughout the deal lifecycle
* Track photography orders, title, and third-party vendor requests
* Record timelines to ensure all parties remain in compliance with contract terms
* Set up and maintain organized deal folders in OneDrive and Outlook

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* 2 to 3 years of experience in transaction coordination, administrative support, or operations, preferably in commercial real estate
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion
* High school diploma required; associate degree preferred

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Salesforce CRM
* Familiarity with real estate closing documents, title commitments, and escrow processes
* Knowledge of auction transactions and multi-state compliance requirements
* Familiarity with tools such as Asana and DocuSign

**Ideal Candidate:**

* Highly organized and process-driven
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment
* Able to problem-solve and adapt as transaction needs evolve
* Professional, responsive, and collaborative in working with internal and external stakeholders
* Committed to accuracy, follow-through, and delivering a high level of support

**Business Development Representative**

**Reports to:** Regional Business Development Director

**Location:** Irvine, California

**Employment type:** Full-time, Exempt

**Bonus Opportunity:** This position is qualified for the discretionary bonus program.

**About Saarman Construction**

At Saarman Construction, you'll help to give existing buildings a second chance to age with grace. From apartments and condominiums to homes and commercial spaces, we reconstruct and revitalize aging buildings while residents and tenants stay in place, with building envelope and waterproofing repairs, seismic retrofitting, and ongoing maintenance that keep them strong for years to come. Environmental stewardship is part of how we work, from recycling and reusing materials to growing our hybrid and electric fleet.

**Position Summary**

Under the general supervision of the Regional Business Development Director, the Business Development Representative identifies, develops, and supports new business opportunities for Saarman. This role prospects and qualifies leads, builds relationships with property owners, managers, and industry partners, and keeps a strong, consistent pipeline of projects flowing to the estimating and operations teams. The position requires regular field travel to properties, client meetings, and industry events. The schedule offers some work-from-home flexibility, with required in-office team meetings.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and research potential clients, properties, and projects within Saarman’s target markets: HOA, affordable and market-rate multifamily, senior living, and hospitality
* Conduct outbound outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, and in-person networking
* Build and maintain relationships with HOA boards and community managers, property management companies, apartment owners and asset managers, REITs, affordable housing operators, building envelope consultants, reserve study firms, and construction defect attorneys
* Qualify leads and schedule introductory meetings and site walks for the business development and estimating teams
* Attend site walks and pre-bid walks to understand project scope and client needs

jobs.title: DESIGNER AND PROJECT COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Olczak Group · Berkeley, CA · Full time, in office, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM · $45 to $55 per hour**

Read this first. This role is in person at our Berkeley studio, five days a week, 8:30 to 5:30 with an hour for lunch. It is paid hourly. If that works for you, keep reading.

We are a licensed architecture practice and a licensed general contractor under one roof, with our own build team. Our work is high end residential in the Bay Area: ground up new homes, gut renovations, and remodels, with budgets that run into the millions. See our work at olczakgroup.com and olczakbuild.com. This seat is two jobs in one. You are the studio's Revit and visualization expert, producing the models, drawing sets, and images behind every project. You are also the coordinator who keeps project information moving so our Project Leads can lead. It is also the seat we promote from. Within your first year you will lead a small project of your own, such as a kitchen, a bath, or a backyard studio, with a Project Lead signing off at each gate.

**What you will do**

Design and production

* Build and maintain the Revit model for each project, from existing conditions through construction documents, under the direction of a Project Lead.
* Produce drawing sets that pass our written quality review the first time.
* Own the studio's Revit standards: templates, families, and the habits that keep models clean.
* Create the renderings and visualizations we use to present designs to clients.
* Contribute design work of your own: studies, options, and details.
* Measure and document existing conditions in the field.

Coordination

* Keep the logs current every day: submittals, RFIs, client selections, and bid tracking.
* Assemble bid packages from our templates, send them to subcontractors, chase the responses, and file them where they belong.
* Take meeting notes, turn them into action items the same day, and follow up until each one is closed.
* Track orders and lead times so nothing lands late on site.
* Support permit submittals: forms, sheets, and the response to comments.
* Keep project files organized to our written standard.

**What the work is really like**

This seat is about 65 percent design and production and 35 percent coordination, and both parts count. One day you are deep in a model. The next you are sending the third email and updating a log. People who want only to design will resent the follow up. People who want only to coordinate will not keep up in Revit. We are looking for the person who likes both, and who wants to run a project of their own.

**Who this fits**

* You hold a degree in architecture.
* You have five or more years of production experience in Revit, and you are the person others ask when a model breaks.
* You produce client ready renderings in V-Ray and Enscape, and your portfolio shows it.
* You have a designer's eye and can develop an idea into a buildable detail.
* You are organized in a way other people can see: your files, your notes, your inbox.
* You communicate before you are asked. If something will be late, we hear it from you first.

**What you get**

* $45 to $55 per hour, with overtime paid.
* A defined path. You lead your first small project within your first year, and we review your progress toward Designer Builder, the next seat up, at twelve months, against written criteria.
* Daily exposure to both design and construction, in the same room as the people doing each.
* Written standards for nearly everything you will be asked to do.
* PTO on accrual basis (per hour worked) for a maximum of 10 days per calendar year @ 40 hrs / week.
* Opportunities for continuing education in building science, architecture, materials, and detailing
* A positive work culture grounded in mutual respect, accountability, and integrity
* Employer subsidized healthcare benefits

**How to apply**

Email your resume and portfolio to careers@olczakgroup.com. The portfolio should include drawing sheets and renderings you produced yourself, with your role stated on each. Use the subject line "Designer and Project Coordinator" followed by your name, and tell us the earliest date you could start. In the body of the email, answer these two questions in 150 words or fewer each:

1.What is the most disorganized project or situation you have inherited, and what did you do first?

2.What is one system you built to keep track of things, and how do you know it works?

Applications without both answers will not be reviewed. Finalists complete a short paid Revit exercise.

Olczak Group is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $45.00 - $55.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Manager, Lyft Ads
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads' vision is to build the largest transportation media network. We leverage media to elevate the transportation experience for our riders while building an exciting and sustainable advertising business. Our advertising opportunities include Lyft in-app homepage and in-ride products, off-platform audience extension retargeting, and IRL experiential executions. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we're looking for someone who's excited to help grow our partnerships.

As an Account Manager, you'll report to the West Coast Account Management Lead and serve as a strategic partner to Account Executives on multiple books of advertiser and agency accounts. You'll own campaigns from pitch through wrap, act as the main day-to-day contact for clients post-sale, and work across Sales, Ad Ops, Product, Data, and other teams to deliver strong results. You'll also help improve the processes and tools our sales team relies on. We're looking for someone who loves solving interesting problems, works well with autonomy, and cares deeply about client success and growth.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Pre-sales planning: Partner with Account Executives on RFP responses and media plans, including inventory forecasting, takeover/events calendar checks, and recommending the right mix of products to meet client goals.
* Data hygiene: Keep pitched and booked inventory and campaign data accurate across internal systems and CRMs, and flag gaps or risks early.
* Post-sales execution: Own all post-sale work for your book of business, including contract execution, creative services, and campaign reporting.
* Cross-functional liaison: Act as the point of contact between clients and Ad Operations, Legal, Product, Engineering, and other teams, resolving issues independently and escalating when needed.
* Ad campaign trafficking and optimization: Partner with Ad Operations to manage direct campaigns via internal planning tools and ad server, including ticketing, setup, scheduling, pacing, and full delivery against Insertion Order terms. Proactively recommend optimizations to improve performance.
* Measurement and reporting: Build campaign and wrap reports, turn results into clear insights and next-step recommendations, and lead measurement studies where applicable.
* Billing: Coordinate with Lyft Billing at the end of each billing cycle on campaign totals and make sure invoices are accurate and delivered on time.
* Client relationships: Own day-to-day client and agency relationships post-sale. Lead check-ins and wrap meetings, and partner with the AE to identify renewal and upsell opportunities.

**Experience:**
---------------

* BA/BS degree and 3-5 years of experience in digital advertising account management, media planning, or campaign management.
* Experience managing client and agency relationships directly and owning a book of business.
* Proficient in Google Suite products, particularly Google Sheets and Drive.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
* Outstanding attention to detail.
* Comfortable managing multiple campaigns across the full ad lifecycle at once, with minimal oversight.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations for sales teams and clients.
* Self-motivated and proactive in finding new solutions before being asked.

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

jobs.title: Community Manager, Executive Social
jobs.description:
We're looking for someone who lives and breathes the internet. Someone who knows what's happening on X before it becomes a headline, understands the nuances of different online communities, tracks the latest platform updates, and instinctively knows when a conversation is worth joining.The ideal candidate is equal parts chronically online, analytically minded, and highly organized. They have impeccable taste, sharp editorial judgment, a strong instinct for compelling social content, and a deep understanding of how influential voices build and engage audiences online. They understand internet culture and humor, know what makes a great meme (and can make one themselves), and can spot emerging trends before they go mainstream. They are naturally curious, closely follow developments in AI, technology, and other fast-moving industries, and understand how to translate complex ideas into content that feels timely, relevant, and culturally resonant.This role will sit within Meta's Executive Communications team, supporting the community engagement of a C-suite executive's social presence across Instagram, Facebook, Threads, and X.This person will play an important role in shaping how a senior executive shows up online, helping our team identify opportunities to participate in relevant conversations, deepen relationships with key communities, and continuously improve our social strategy.We're looking for someone who understands that effective social media is about more than publishing content. It's about understanding audiences, knowing how to read the room, recognizing emerging conversations, and creating meaningful engagement.The right person will be highly detail-oriented, proactive, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of exercising sound judgment in a fast-moving, high-visibility environment.  
  
  

### **Community Manager, Executive Social Responsibilities:**

* Community management and engagement: Monitor comments, replies, mentions, and relevant conversations across platforms to identify opportunities for the executive to engage with individuals, creators, and communities
* Social listening and cultural intelligence: Stay deeply connected to internet culture, emerging trends, platform developments, and relevant conversations across technology, AI, business, and culture. Proactively surface opportunities for engagement and content
* Editorial judgment: Understand the nuances of different online communities and recommend when, where, and how the executive should participate in conversations, including when not to engage
* Content planning and coordination: Partner with the broader Executive Communications team to maintain editorial calendars, coordinate publishing workflows, and ensure visibility into upcoming announcements, content, and engagement opportunities
* Social-first content: Work closely with writers, creative partners, and the broader team to develop and refine content that feels native to each platform and resonates with its intended audience
* Measurement and insights: Partner with the Executive Communications team to track content performance, community engagement, audience growth, and sentiment. Help translate data into actionable insights and recommendations
* Testing and optimization: Identify opportunities to experiment with new formats, publishing approaches, platform features, and engagement tactics. Analyze results and recommend ways to improve performance
* Audience intelligence: Develop a deep understanding of the audiences and communities engaging with the executive's content, including key creators, influential voices, emerging communities, and relevant conversations
* Issue identification and escalation: Identify emerging issues or reputational risks and work closely with the Communications team to recommend appropriate responses
* Platform expertise: Maintain a strong understanding of social platform algorithms, product updates, best practices, and emerging capabilities, proactively sharing relevant developments with the team

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of experience managing social media channels for a high-profile individual, executive, creator, media organization, or consumer-facing brand
* Demonstrated experience publishing and managing content across major social platforms, particularly Instagram, Facebook, Threads, and X
* Experience applying knowledge of internet culture, emerging social trends, and online community behaviors to inform content and engagement strategies
* Experience managing social communities, identifying engagement opportunities, and responding to audiences with sound judgment
* Experience with social listening, analytics, reporting, and performance measurement
* Experience managing editorial calendars, coordinating across multiple workstreams, and delivering against tight deadlines
* Experience working cross-functionally with communications, creative, and other partners
* Ability to exercise discretion and sound judgment when working with high-profile individuals and sensitive information
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience using audience insights, sentiment analysis, and performance data to inform social strategy
* Understanding of how social platforms contribute to reputation, influence, and long-term audience relationships
* Demonstrated ability to identify emerging online conversations and translate them into relevant engagement opportunities
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Deep familiarity with X, IG, Threads and FB and its technology and AI communities

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - HQ
jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative**

  

**Reports to:** Regional Business Development Director

**Location:** Alameda - CA headquarters

**Employment type:** Full-time, Exempt

**Bonus Opportunity:** This position is qualified for the discretionary bonus program.

  

**About Saarman Construction**

At Saarman Construction, you'll help to give existing buildings a second chance to age with grace. From apartments and condominiums to homes and commercial spaces, we reconstruct and revitalize aging buildings while residents and tenants stay in place, with building envelope and waterproofing repairs, seismic retrofitting, and ongoing maintenance that keep them strong for years to come. Environmental stewardship is part of how we work, from recycling and reusing materials to growing our hybrid and electric fleet.

  

**Position Summary**

Under the general supervision of the Regional Business Development Director, the Business Development Representative identifies, develops, and supports new business opportunities for Saarman. This role prospects and qualifies leads, builds relationships with property owners, managers, and industry partners, and keeps a strong, consistent pipeline of projects flowing to the estimating and operations teams. The position requires regular field travel to properties, client meetings, and industry events. The schedule offers some work-from-home flexibility, with required in-office team meetings.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and research potential clients, properties, and projects within Saarman’s target markets: HOA, affordable and market-rate multifamily, senior living, and hospitality
* Conduct outbound outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, and in-person networking
* Build and maintain relationships with HOA boards and community managers, property management companies, apartment owners and asset managers, REITs, affordable housing operators, building envelope consultants, reserve study firms, and construction defect attorneys
* Qualify leads and schedule introductory meetings and site walks for the business development and estimating teams
* Attend site walks and pre-bid walks to understand project scope and client needs
* Monitor bid platforms, RFPs, and upcoming projects, and help assemble Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) and proposal packages
* Present Saarman’s capabilities to HOA boards, ownership groups, and property management teams
* Follow up on submitted bids and proposals to keep opportunities moving toward award
* Track all activities, leads, and opportunities in the CRM and keep pipeline data current
* Collaborate with marketing, estimating, and operations to align messaging, offerings, and client hand-offs
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Saarman’s services, market trends, and competitors

  

**Trade Shows and Events**

* Help choose which trade shows, association events, and networking meetings to attend, based on target clients and markets
* Before each event: review attendee and exhibitor lists, identify target contacts, and set meetings in advance
* Coordinate with the Marketing Representative on booth materials, giveaways, and collateral (Marketing manages registrations and logistics)
* Staff the booth and attend sessions, mixers, and client dinners, representing Saarman professionally
* Capture leads and contact information at every event and enter them in the CRM within 48 hours
* Follow up with every new contact within one week and turn event conversations into meetings and site walks
* Help plan and host Saarman client events, lunch-and-learns, and community manager education sessions

  

**Travel:** Regular local field travels; occasional overnight travel within California and Hawaii.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales, or account management (construction, property management, or related industry preferred)
* Excellent verbal and written communication and relationship-building skills
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong time management and the ability to handle multiple opportunities at once
* Self-directed with a high level of initiative, and able to work successfully within a team
* Basic understanding of construction services or bidding processes
* Experience using a CRM system
* Committed to delivering outstanding customer service and quality work
* Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and proof of auto insurance

  

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with HOAs, community management, or multifamily property management; CAI involvement a plus
* Knowledge of exterior repair, waterproofing, or construction defect work

  

**Work Environment**

* Hybrid schedule with work-from-home flexibility and required in-office team meetings
* Regular field travel to properties, job sites, client offices, and industry events, including some evening HOA board meetings and events
* Occasional overnight travel within California and Hawaii

jobs.description:
Description:

As a Summer Residency Lab Production Assistant, you’ll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in the new play development process by helping facilitate a welcoming, fun space for Ground Floor artists during their time at Berkeley Rep.

Production Assistants are primarily responsible for shuttling artists between the airport, our housing, and offices, setting up and taking down our nightly communal dinners, daily kitchen maintenance, and collaborating closely with the seasonal and Berkeley Rep staff on day-to-day tasks related to hospitality and production. Production Assistants are hired from 4 to 6 weeks to work at Berkeley Repertory Theatre.

Requirements:

Production Assistants should be available between June 21st, 2027 and August 8th, 2027. Schedules vary daily and may include morning, evening or weekend hours between 8am-10pm for up to 40 hours per week. This position requires light physical activity, with reasonable accommodations available. Production assistants will be expected to drive our company vehicles including a seven-passenger van; a valid driver's license is required. Production Assistants must be 21 years or older to operate company vehicles.

**Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis and are due no later than 5pm PT on Monday, February 01, 2027.**

**Rate: $23.50/hour**

**Questions?** Email us at groundfloor@berkeleyrep.org.

jobs.description:
**Job description**

Seeking a top-tier Assistant Project Manager for high-end residential construction

Are you looking for a challenge and opportunity to grow? Are you interested in working on architecturally-driven, high-end residential projects throughout Northern California? FORMA Construction, an award-winning firm, seeks a motivated, detail-oriented Assistant Project Manager to help build the most complex and detailed projects.

The Assistant Project Manager role is a critical hub for FORMA. In coordination with the Project Manager and the Superintendent; the APM works closely with clients, architects, designers, subcontractors, and other vendors. The APM tracks progress and updates budgets while keeping the project well-documented and running smoothly ensuring that our clients are informed and consulted every step of the way.

Success in this role is measured by your ability to maintain project documents like RFI's and Submittals among other tasks within Procore while maintaining good relations with our clients, vendors, and other stakeholders.

At FORMA, our Mission is the continual development of our people and processes to create lasting relationships built on integrity, partnership, and craft. Our core values are based on building relationships, collaborating to create the best possible outcomes, mutual respect, continued growth, and excellent craftsmanship. FORMA’s clients and work sites take us throughout the greater Bay Area, building a range of styles and requirements, but all our projects share the same level of dedication, detail, and communication. Our Assistant Project Manager will ensure that our clients receive the best possible service, while continuing to build their experience in project management.

**Responsibilities**:

* Assist with document control including RFI’s, submittals, subcontractor bids and documentation, change orders, schedule updates, drawings, and meeting minutes.
* Ensure projects and subcontractors are properly set up in Sage and Procore.
* Coordinate with Superintendent to ensure daily logs, photo documentation, and required postings are correct and up to date.
* Interface with City and County government in relation to permits, parking, and inspections.
* Coordinate on site project set up, ensuring basic office supplies, safety equipment, required postings, toilets and utilities are in place for the project.
* Schedule, set agendas, produce documentation and logs, and take notes for project meetings.
* Manage and update punch list for project.
* Assemble close out package for clients at the end of the project, including Maintenance and Service information and schedule.
* Participate in weekly Maintenance and Service meeting, schedule all maintenance, and distribute service schedule to the service team.
* Regularly interface with clients, answering questions, keeping them up to date on their projects, and contacting them about needed maintenance and service on their completed projects.

**Requirements:**

* Construction project management experience.
* Degree in a related field.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
* Ability to speak, read, and write in English.
* Ability to multitask and handle multiple high priority tasks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent customer service.
* Strong computer skills, experience with Microsoft suite, Smartsheet, and Procore.
* Team-oriented and willing to work with others to achieve results.

* 401k with employer matching.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*

jobs.title: Residency/Fellowship Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  
  
*For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.

**Position Summary:**  
We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Residency/Fellowship Program Coordinator.
  
  
In this role, the successful candidate manages the administrative operations of four orthopedic fellowship programs, including accreditation, recruitment, training requirements, budgets, and visiting/traveling fellowship activities. Leads the administrative preparation of an ACGME accreditation application for one fellowship and plans the operational work needed for another fellowship to add a sixth fellow. Reviews program requirements and records, identifies risks, develops administrative procedures, and recommends solutions to Program Directors and departmental leadership. Program Directors retain authority over educational, clinical, fellow-complement, and formal accreditation decisions.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Independently manage the annual operating plans for four fellowship programs. Create a master calendar showing each programs recruitment dates, training start and end dates, evaluation deadlines, accreditation submissions, and required committee meetings. Identify conflicting deadlines and decide how to adjust administrative work plans.
* For the fellowship seeking ACGME accreditation, review the specialty-specific ACGME Program Requirements and prepare a checklist showing every required document, policy, faculty qualification, training experience, and institutional approval. Identify missing items, assign follow-up owners, and recommend solutions to the Program Director.
* Lead preparation of the new fellowship accreditation application: collect faculty CVs and qualifications, draft administrative sections, compile rotation schedules and educational goals, confirm participating-site information, gather institutional approvals, and organize supporting evidence for Program Director review and submission through the required ACGME process.
* Analyze the proposed fellowship curriculum against ACGME requirements. Compare planned rotations, supervision, teaching conferences, evaluations, and fellow experiences with the applicable standards. Prepare a written gap report and recommend changes to schedules or administrative procedures for leadership approval.
* Create and maintain an accreditation action plan for the new fellowship. Set internal deadlines, identify delays that could affect the application or planned fellow start date, propose alternatives, and provide regular written progress reports to the Program Director and Senior Program Manager.
* For each currently accredited fellowship, review the applicable ACGME requirements and institutional GME policies at least annually. Compare program records with required standards, identify missing evidence or recurring problems, and recommend and implement administrative fixes within approved policies.
* Manage the administrative preparation of ACGME Accreditation Data System (ADS) updates and other required reports for applicable programs. Check faculty rosters, program information, participating sites, and required entries for accuracy; resolve data discrepancies and route items requiring Program Director attestation or approval.
* Analyze fellow and faculty evaluation completion rates, duty-hour records where applicable, and other required training data. Identify patterns such as repeated overdue evaluations or missing documentation; design follow-up procedures and report unresolved compliance concerns to program leadership.
* Plan and manage administrative work for Clinical Competency Committee and Program Evaluation Committee meetings where required. Prepare data summaries, track action items and deadlines, compare findings across review periods, and recommend process changes; faculty committees make educational judgments and competency decision
* Review fellowship rotation schedules and training records to confirm required experiences are planned and documented. Identify schedule gaps, overlapping assignments, or missing site requirements; develop proposed administrative solutions and coordinate approved changes with faculty and institutional offices.
* Independently develop recruitment plans for four fellowships, including application deadlines, interview capacity, faculty availability, applicant communications, and match timelines where applicable. Review prior recruitment results and recommend changes to interview-day operations and applicant communication processes. Program Directors make applicant selection and ranking decisions.
* Assess onboarding risks for incoming fellows by reviewing credentialing, licensing, visa sponsorship where applicable, required training, and institutional appointment deadlines. Create a program-specific readiness plan, identify obstacles early, and work with GME, HR, immigration, and credentialing offices to resolve administrative barriers; authorized offices make eligibility and visa decisions.
* Review fellowship budgets and planned expenses across the four programs. Compare actual spending with approved allocations, identify unusual costs or funding gaps, recommend spending priorities or cost-saving op

* Work closely with families, parents, and guardians to ensure the needs of students are met

* A minimum of four years of relevant experience working with children in an educational setting is preferred
* At least two years experience supervising staff and managing programs is preferred
* Strong leadership, conflict-resolution and diplomacy skills
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and multitask in a fast-paced environment

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Computer proficiency including Microsoft Word and Excel, email correspondence, and database management is required

jobs.title: Academic Program Coordinator (Graduate Accountancy Programs)
jobs.description:
Academic Program Coordinator (Graduate Accountancy Programs)

**POSITION DETAILS**

**”At Baruch College we believe that student success is everyone’s responsibility"**

The Graduate Accountancy Programs Coordinator serves as an essential member of the Graduate Accountancy Programs team, providing student-facing, administrative, and programmatic support for MBA and MS Accountancy students. Reporting directly to the Director of Graduate Accountancy Programs, the Coordinator supports a high-volume graduate student population and contributes to enrollment management, academic advising support, student records and academic processes, degree progression, and program coordination.

Working under the direction of the Director and in collaboration with faculty and administrative offices, the Coordinator helps ensure the effective day-to-day operation of the graduate Accountancy programs. The position serves as a key point of contact for students, provides information and guidance within established policies and procedures, maintains accurate student and program records, and coordinates routine academic and administrative processes.

The position requires sound judgment, strong organizational and analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex academic environment.
