jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
Collections today works like an emergency room. The doctors carry too many patients, everyone arrives at their worst moment, and nobody has their chart. We're making it primary care. January personalizes interactions and optimizes decisions across every stage of consumer credit. We started in the hardest, most broken stage, because if it works there it works anywhere.

Most consumers want to pay what they owe. They want a way out, not a break. We've serviced over $20 billion in debt across more than 20 million consumers. We see more people with charged-off loans each year than all but the top five US banks. Those consumers rate us about 50% higher than the banks that lent them the money. Creditors net over 30% more because we collect more and charge less.

Most AI strips the human out of the work. We use it to make someone's hardest financial moment more human. The more human we make it, the more people recover. Now we're moving upstream, catching people before they default and building across every stage of the consumer credit lifecycle. The consumer in collections today is the consumer who gets approved tomorrow.

**About the Role**
==================

January is growing, and every hire we make depends on a recruiting process that moves quickly and treats candidates like the exceptional talent they are. As our sole Recruiting Coordinator, you’ll be be the face of January throughout the candidate journey. You own their experience end to end: every confirmation, reschedule, onsite, and follow-up is a chance to make the best possible impression on a candidate. Behind the scenes, you’ll be the operational backbone of our recruiting function, covering communications, scheduling, onsite logistics, and Ashby hygiene across every role.

Done well, recruiting feels seamless for candidates and for the team. Candidates always know what’s next, and no one on our side has to ask whether we’ve reached out to a candidate, whether an interview needs to be rescheduled, or when an onsite is happening, because you’ve already handled it and told the right people. Your work decides whether a great candidate with another offer on the table hears from us in minutes or in days, and whether they leave every interaction excited about working at January.

This role is for a proactive, detail-oriented, and strategic operator who looks around corners to see bottlenecks before they form and sweats the details that make candidates feel valued. You’ll build real relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers. And you’ll set coordination up to run without you in the room, using AI to take over the repetitive work so you can spend more time on the human moments.

**You Will**
============

* **Delight every candidate at every step.** Be a warm, responsive, and polished point of contact from first outreach through offer. Set clear expectations on timing and next steps, prepare candidates for each interview, and make sure no one is left wondering where they stand.
* **Run an interview calendar without surprises.** Own scheduling, confirmations, and reschedules in Ashby across time zones, including same-day swaps when conflicts hit. Hold interviewer load to weekly caps, flag over- and underutilized interviewers, and build expedited loops (full process and debrief) around a candidate’s competing offer deadline.
* **Own onsites and internal setup for each pipeline.** Plan onsite logistics so every visit feels welcoming and well organized. Set up each role at kickoff, send interviewer briefs before every invite, and keep interviewers trained and calibrated on the experience we want candidates to have. Schedule debriefs with enough notice for the panel to prep.
* **Keep Ashby and candidate logistics correct.** Own role setup from approval to first interview, candidate communications, and the handoff to HR at offer. Keep interviewers, stages, and statuses current so the team works from one source of truth, and share the weekly scheduling read (time to booking, reschedule rate, interviewer load) with recruiters. Pair it with candidate feedback so we know how the experience feels from the other side.
* **Make coordination survive anyone’s absence.** Own the coordination SOP, train backups and recruiters, and turn recurring problems into Ashby automations and AI-assisted workflows. Bring recurring problems to recruiters with a proposed fix.

**What We Need**
================

* You treat every candidate interaction as a reflection of January. You write warm, clear, personal messages, anticipate questions before candidates ask them, and advocate for the candidate experience in every decision, even when it’s the harder path internally.
* You catch errors before they reach a candidate: the wrong time zone, another role’s guide, a double-booked interviewer. You build checks into the process so accuracy doesn’t depend on having a good day.
* You treat a time-sensitive change as the first task of the day. You resolve same-day swaps and competing-offer deadlines in minutes, and respond to the real deadline, not the loudest request. You acknowledge every request quickly, with a clear view on when it will be resolved.
* You keep a dozen requests moving and order the queue by deadline, business impact, and candidate risk. When constraints collide, you make the call if it’s reversible, and escalate with a recommendation if it isn’t.
* You don’t wait for direction. You close every loop without being chased, flag early when something is stuck, and chase interviewers and hiring managers for feedback, availability, and prep. You identify potential blockers before they become real problems.
* You communicate in a way that can’t be misread, and you build real relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders. You hold the line with senior leaders when needed to protect the candidate’s experience and timeline.
* You turn a fix you make twice into a rule, template, or automation, documented so anyone else can run

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Fundwell**
------------------

Fundwell helps small and medium-sized businesses access capital with greater clarity, speed, and confidence. Our financial technology platform brings financing options and experienced specialists together, helping business owners compare offers, understand their choices, and move from application to funding through a streamlined process.  
  
We combine technology with personal guidance because financing is more than a transaction it can help a business hire its next employee, purchase equipment, or pursue its next stage of growth. Our team makes those decisions easier to navigate, building relationships grounded in transparency and trust.

**Your Role at Fundwell**
-------------------------

Build your sales career where great sales careers start: on the phone.  
  
As an Opener, you are the first voice a business owner hears from Fundwell. You’ll make high-volume cold calls, supported by email and text, to reach business owners, find out what they need, and bring in the application that starts their path to funding. Then you’ll hand the deal to one of our closers with everything they need to take it from there.  
  
This role is built for people who want to get good at sales, fast. You’ll learn a proven call framework, get daily coaching and call reviews, and watch your confidence grow with every dial. You don’t need years of experience. You need drive, resilience, and a real willingness to pick up the phone.  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact**

**Drive outreach**

* Make high-volume outbound calls each day and meet your activity goals.
* Reach business owners and turn conversations into applications.
* Stay resilient and keep your energy up through every call.

**Lead strong conversations**

* Follow a proven sales approach on every call.
* Understand each business owner’s needs and goals.
* Handle objections with confidence and move every conversation forward.
* Set clear, accurate expectations.

**Follow through**

* Follow up consistently across channels.
* Deliver complete applications and a smooth handoff to the next stage.
* Keep clear, organized records.

**Grow with the team**

* Use coaching and feedback to keep improving.
* Act with honesty and integrity with every customer.
* Bring energy that helps make the team a great place to work.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Activity:** You stay consistent and hit your daily activity goals.
* **Conversations:** You run quality conversations that uncover what each customer needs.
* **Applications:** You make it easy for clients to get through the application process.
* **Organization:** You keep clear records so anyone on the team can pick up where you left off.
* **Growth:** You take coaching and feedback seriously and keep getting better.

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Full-funnel paid social strategy:** Build and execute a paid social strategy that spans awareness through demo requests, with clear objectives for each stage of the buyer journey. Measure the program's contribution to pipeline and adjust channel strategy based on performance.
* **Hands-on campaign management:** Build, launch, and manage campaigns directly in Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit. Run targeted, small-scale tests on emerging or relevant platforms, including X, when there's a clear audience fit.
* **Testing and optimization:** Continuously refine campaign structure and test audiences, creative, messaging, and placements to improve results. Use AI tools to develop ad copy variants, explore audience hypotheses, and streamline reporting. Share findings and recommendations for program expansion with the Director of Growth Marketing.
* **Performance analysis:** Regularly analyze channel and campaign performance to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and demand generation. Use performance data to determine which campaigns to scale, adjust, or optimize.
* **Budget management:** Own the paid social budget, forecast spend, and manage pacing against monthly and quarterly plans. Identify budget or performance risks early and recommend adjustments to keep investment aligned with program objectives.
* **Cross-channel collaboration:** Partner with paid search and other media channel owners to align messaging and share campaign insights. Work with Creative, Product Marketing, Web, and Marketing Operations to bring coordinated campaigns to market. Demonstrate The Team is Pendo by sharing results openly and incorporating Sales feedback into campaign improvements.

**Who You Are**
---------------

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Digital Marketing Managers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

**Must-haves**
--------------

* 3–5 years of paid social marketing experience, including recent, hands-on experience building and managing campaigns in Meta and LinkedIn to reach niche audiences.
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a paid social program that generated measurable demand, drove demo requests, and contributed to pipeline.
* Strong analytical skills with experience translating campaign performance data into decisions about what to test, adjust, and scale.
* Experience owning paid social budgets, forecasting spend, and managing pacing against monthly and quarterly plans.
* Experience collaborating with Creative, Product Marketing, Web, Analytics, and technical teams to launch coordinated marketing campaigns.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in paid social workflows, including reporting, audience exploration, or creative development. Ability to explain how those tools were used, what worked, and their impact on performance.
* Demonstrated Bias to Act through launching tests, evaluating results, and applying insights to improve subsequent campaigns.

**Nice-to-haves**
-----------------

* Experience working in B2B SaaS, a high-growth company, or a startup.
* Experience developing Meta into a meaningful B2B demand generation channel.
* Experience managing paid social campaigns on Reddit, X, or other social platforms beyond Meta and LinkedIn.

**About Pendo**
---------------

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

**Pendo Core Values:** Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

**Location:** Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.

**Compensation:** The expected salary range for this role to be performed in Raleigh, NC is $102,600 - $123,000. The expected salary range for this role to be performed in New York, NY is $112,800 - $135,000.

**Benefits:** Highly competitive, employer-heavy coverage (including $0 premium options), strong 401(k) match, equity, and flex

jobs.description:
**About the Metropolitan Museum of Art**

The Met presents over 5,000 years of art from around the world for everyone to experience and enjoy. The Museum lives in two iconic sites in New York City—The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Cloisters. Millions of people also take part in The Met experience online.

Since its founding in 1870, The Met has always aspired to be more than a treasury of rare and beautiful objects. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and respectful work environment with a staff as diverse as the audiences we engage. Our staff members are art lovers who are passionate about working toward a common goal: creating the most dynamic and inspiring art museum in the world.

At The Met, every staff member – from security officers to researchers to scientists and beyond – lives by our core values of respect, inclusivity, collaboration, excellence, and integrity.

**Respect:** Engage one another with collegiality, empathy, and kindness, always.

**Inclusivity:** Ensure that all are and feel welcome and valued.

**Collaboration:** Reach across boundaries to exchange ideas and work together toward our shared mission.

**Excellence:** Lead the cultural world in quality and expertise—and inspire curiosity and creativity.

**Integrity:** Hold ourselves to the highest moral standards, admit when we fall short, and then evolve.

**GENERAL STATEMENT OF RESPONSIBILITES & DUTIES:**
--------------------------------------------------

As the Development Assistant for Events, you will provide administrative support for the Development events team which oversees approximately 60–80 events annually. You will assist with managing guests lists, responses, RSVP, and guest data. You will process benefit ticket sales, gift acknowledgements and reporting. You will provide floor level event support before, during, and after events.

* Assist with benefit ticket sales, gift acknowledgements, and record-keeping
* Manage internal calendars on multiple platforms (i.e., Outlook, Airtable, Artifax, etc.)
* Follow best practices for the management, use, and governance of the enterprise system, ensuring quality assurance and data integrity, and work with Institutional Advancement Operations team to oversee integration of external event invitation and database system (Launchmetrics) with Tessitura database
* Provide general assistance with event logistics before, during, and after events (includes some nights and weekends)
* Provide procurement support, including ensuring compliance with all Museum policies and procedures related to purchasing goods and services and submitting requisitions, supplier invoice requests, and other forms for payment, for the Administrator of the Development Office with regard to their role as the Procurement Ambassador for Development
* Plan and execute smaller-scale events and program as needed
* Other duties as assigned

**REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Thorough knowledge of and experience with Tessitura (or comparable donor database), including list management, constituent updating, and reporting
* Candidate should be a self-starter and feel comfortable working independently, with the ability to multitask several projects at once
* Outstanding ability to work well under pressure on a variety of projects; candidate should be comfortable working in a very fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment
* Due to significant top-level donor contact, excellent interpersonal skills are essential (professional, discrete, and diplomatic)
* Previous events and/or Development experience required
* Meticulous attention to detail required
* Must be able to lift 50 pounds (some physical work will be required.)
* Computer literacy (Microsoft Office) required; previous experience with Photoshop preferred

**COMPENSATION**

* Pay Rate: $32 - $34 / Hourly

The advertised pay scale reflects the good faith minimum and maximum salary range for this role. The advertised pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage for any specific employee. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, special licensing or qualifications, and other factors.

**Visa Sponsorship**

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Location Requirements**

At time of employment, employees are expected to be located within commuting distance of the Museum. “Commuting distance” means that they are located in one of following states: New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, or Pennsylvania (the “Tri-state and PA” areas), and be able to commute to and from the Museum in a single day.

**Benefits Offerings**

The Museum provides competitive compensation, and generous benefits and perks for all eligible employees. **Note:** Benefits Offering may differ based on Employee Status.

* Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* 403(b) basic retirement plan and optional matching retirement plan with an outstanding employer match
* Considerable paid time off, including annual leave, sick leave, and 13 Museum holidays

* Flexible Spending Accounts & Health Savings Account (pre-tax income for eligible health care expenses)

* Free financial-planning services

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Social Media Coordinator & Evaluator**

**PCI Professional Services**

**Position Summary**

PCI Professional Services is seeking an experienced **Social Media Coordinator & Evaluator** to support digital communications initiatives within the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's (CDC) Global Health Center (GHC), Office of the Associate Director for Communication (ADC).

The successful candidate will support the planning, coordination, execution, and evaluation of social media communications designed to advance CDC's global public health mission. This position requires a combination of strategic communications expertise, content development capabilities, stakeholder coordination, and data-driven performance analysis.

The Social Media Coordinator & Evaluator will collaborate with CDC communications professionals, subject matter experts, and technical teams to ensure social media content is accurate, accessible, timely, and aligned with organizational priorities and federal communications standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media Strategy & Coordination**

* Coordinate the development and implementation of social media communications strategies supporting GHC priorities and initiatives.
* Develop and maintain editorial calendars to organize content, campaigns, publication schedules, and communication milestones.
* Collaborate with CDC stakeholders and subject matter experts to identify opportunities for audience engagement and public health messaging.
* Support integrated digital communications campaigns across multiple social media platforms.
* Monitor emerging social media trends and recommend approaches to strengthen audience engagement and content effectiveness.

**Content Development & Publishing**

* Develop, edit, and coordinate social media content that communicates complex public health information clearly and effectively.
* Prepare platform-specific messaging, graphics, and supporting materials consistent with CDC communications guidelines.
* Coordinate content reviews, approvals, and publication schedules with designated CDC stakeholders.
* Publish approved content using established social media management tools and workflows.
* Ensure content aligns with accessibility, plain-language, branding, and applicable federal communications requirements.

**Social Media Monitoring & Evaluation**

* Monitor social media activity, audience engagement, and campaign performance across designated platforms.
* Track key performance indicators, including reach, impressions, engagement rates, audience growth, and campaign effectiveness.
* Develop recurring performance reports, dashboards, and analytical summaries.
* Evaluate communication outcomes and identify opportunities to improve content strategy, audience targeting, and engagement.
* Translate social media analytics into actionable recommendations for CDC communications leadership.

**Stakeholder Coordination & Reporting**

* Collaborate with CDC communications teams, program offices, and subject matter experts to coordinate messaging and communications priorities.
* Support planning meetings, campaign development discussions, and communication reviews.
* Prepare status updates, performance summaries, and recommendations for government stakeholders.
* Maintain organized documentation of content calendars, campaign activities, performance metrics, and approval workflows.
* Support continuous improvement of social media processes, reporting practices, and communications effectiveness.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Journalism, Digital Media, or a related field.
* Equivalent combinations of education and relevant professional experience may be considered, subject to contract requirements.

**Experience**

* Minimum of **four years of relevant professional experience** in social media management, digital communications, public relations, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience developing, coordinating, and publishing social media content across multiple platforms.
* Experience managing editorial calendars and coordinating communications campaigns.
* Experience analyzing social media metrics and preparing performance reports.
* Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and coordinating stakeholder reviews and approvals.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency with social media management and analytics platforms such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Meltwater, or comparable tools.
* Experience using digital analytics and reporting tools to evaluate communications performance.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams.
* Familiarity with graphic design and content development applications such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva.
* Knowledge of digital accessibility principles, including Section 508 requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting CDC, HHS, or other federal government communications programs.
* Experience developing communications related to public health, global health, or scientific topics.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical information into accessible, audience-focused messaging.
* Experience developing performance dashboards, campaign evaluations, and recommendations informed by audience analytics.
* Familiarity with federal communications clearance processes, branding requirements, and social media governance.
* Experience supporting executive communications and coordinating content across multiple organizational stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of digital communications trends, audience segmentation, and engagement strategies.

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Communications
* Social Media Management
* Digital Content Development
* Performance Measurement & Evaluation
* Data Analysis & Reporting
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Project Coordination
* Written & Verbal Communication
* Atte

---------------

AWS is seeking a sales professional to manage a global customer relationship with one of our large global Automotive & Manufacturing customers. You will define and execute a CXO relationship strategy within the account, including engaging with a dedicated account team, AWS senior leaders for executive sponsorship, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction.  
  
The Global Account Manager ("GAM") will partner with the customer to build strategic relationships, articulate a clear vision, and deliver business value. The successful GAM will develop and execute a broad strategy for earning customer trust and driving AWS solution and service adoption across the customer's Digital Technology, Operations, Line of Business (LoB), and Research & Development leadership. The GAM will work with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solution Architects, Customer Solutions Managers, Industry Specialists, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service Teams and Professional Services) to deliver customer outcomes. Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Contributing to, and leading, within an AWS customer account team.  
  
Identifying and building trusted advisor relationships with key influencers and decision-makers, specifically CxOs at the customer, across Line of Business (LoB), Functional (R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain), and Digital & IT.  
  
Working closely with internal AWS teams (executives, solution architects, industry specialists, marketing, partners, enterprise support, service teams and professional services), as well as external SI and ISV partners, to support the best business solution(s) for customers.  
  
Defining a CXO relationship strategy within the customer, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction levels.  
  
Displaying strong leadership presence and being able to command a room in a meeting. Should be seen as an authority in communicating via email, phone, and face to face, and comfortable writing executive briefing documents for, and communicating with, the most senior executives at the company.  
  
Operating with significant autonomy and discretion. A high degree of decision making is required in routine customer engagement, business judgment is critical.

By partnering closely with super users and executive sponsors, the Customer Success Executive ensures the QGenda platform is meeting enterprise needs while expanding realized value across the organization. The CSX is responsible not only for driving adoption, but also for helping customers define success metrics, track progress, and understand the operational and financial value achieved through QGenda.

Customer Success Executives leverage best practices, customer insights, and deep QGenda product knowledge when leading post go-live initiatives. They develop trusted advisor relationships with key stakeholders, clearly articulate outcomes and ROI to executive audiences, and open the door for system-wide growth opportunities grounded in demonstrated customer value.

As a critical member of the Customer Success team, you will strategically guide enterprise customers through their QGenda journey, utilizing personal touch, technical expertise, and outcome-oriented engagement to increase adoption, drive expansion, demonstrate realized value, and ensure long-term customer retention.

* Own success, renewal, and long-term value realization across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers, maintaining continuous visibility into account health, risks, and growth opportunities
* Partner with customers to define success metrics and baseline outcomes, track progress over time, and connect QGenda usage to measurable operational, financial, or workforce impact
* Drive adoption and optimization of the QGenda platform in service of customer-defined outcomes, not just feature utilization
* Proactively identify emerging risks early and serve as the primary point of escalation for assigned accounts, exercising independent judgment to align internal teams and resolve complex issues
* Lead the development and execution of recovery or “get well” plans when accounts are at risk, remaining accountable through resolution
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer executive and operational leaders, earning credibility through preparation, insight, and clear points of view
* Lead Executive Business Reviews and other strategic engagements, presenting a data-backed narrative on realized value, risks, and recommended next actions aligned to customer priorities

jobs.title: Field Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Caliber Car Wash was founded in 2018 in Atlanta, GA. The goal of the founders was to build a “best-in-class” car wash company with a focus on improving the customer experience. Today, the company operates 63 locations throughout the Southeast US and Texas. The company is projected to grow to 100+ stores in the next three years! Caliber is dedicated to the communities it serves through superior customer service. If you are a solutions-oriented, proactive service industry leader seeking an opportunity with a growing organization that cares about its people, we need to talk!

**Our Purpose**

Caliber exists to *Improve People’s Lives* by providing career opportunities and professional growth to our team members and by providing exceptional service worth our customers’ loyalty.

**Role Summary**

The Field Marketing Manager owns how marketing runs at store level and in the field: the local store marketing playbook and operating system, field activations, signage and in-store execution, organic social, and coordination with field teams. Reports to the VP, Marketing, and serves as the VP’s right hand for field marketing, trusted to make decisions and keep the work moving; runs the field playbook end to end while Creative, CRM, and paid media own their lanes. This role manages systems, programs, and partners rather than direct reports. Works in person at Caliber stores and supports and coordinates activations for all Caliber locations, digitally and with local field support. Atlanta-based is preferred but not required; candidates based elsewhere travel monthly to Caliber markets in Atlanta, Dallas, or Florida.

This role exists to make marketing easier for the field, not to add to its workload. Success means district and site managers trust marketing, call marketing when something happens, and see results at their stores. The ideal candidate is a thinker as much as a doer: a people person who understands how marketing thinks, solves problems without waiting to be told how, and is ready to step up and own a program. They have experience running grassroots and local store marketing for a multi-unit retail or service brand; are hands-on, detail-oriented, and operator-minded; and expect to spend real time in the field working with field operations teams. They will also have a real hand in shaping how Caliber’s local store marketing system looks and works as it is built out.

Car wash may not be the first industry that comes to mind for a marketing career, and that is exactly the opportunity. Express car wash is a fast-growing, membership-driven business built on the same subscription model that powers streaming, software, and fitness brands. In this role, you’ll see firsthand how recurring revenue works: acquiring members, converting single-wash customers, and reducing churn, all measured store by store. Few roles at this stage of a marketing career combine hands-on local marketing with subscription-business experience, and both skill sets carry into any industry you choose next.

**Responsibilities**

The essential functions of this role include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Run Caliber’s local store marketing operating system and playbook.  
  Own the day-to-day system that site managers, district managers, and marketing use to plan and request local activity: work the marketing queue, keep store and district views current, and move plays from request to approval to launch. Manage the local store activation budget, measure what each play returns, and bring forward recommendations that shape how the system and playbook evolve.
* Drive local store marketing and grassroots activation that lifts store traffic.  
  Leverage a trade-area profile for each store (schools, employers, apartments, competitors, events) and turn it into activity: fundraisers with schools, teams, and nonprofits; affinity program activations; business, apartment, and other local partnerships; and community events. Run plays from the local store marketing playbook, built around the situational needs of individual car wash locations. Diagnose before prescribing, prioritize stores by need rather than spreading effort evenly, and measure through predetermined KPIs and store-level lift. In markets where stores are more spread out, such as Florida and Texas, coordinate activations with local field support, which may include contract partners.
* Own store-level marketing execution across signage, merchandising, and promotions.  
  Coordinate signage needs from a catalog; manage promo swaps, new-store and refresh rollouts, POS screen content, digital menus / reader boards, in-store merchandising, and store audits to ensure campaigns are live and accurate.
* Creatively produce organic social and community content as needed.
* Lead field marketing requests and cross-functional follow-through.  
  Serve as the marketing intake point for district and site managers. Turn field signals into action and close the loop on every request. Coordinate with Creative, CRM, paid media, Ops, IT, vendors, and webstore partners.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Degree not required, but a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, public relations, business, or a related field is preferred. In its place, relevant experience, creativity, and curiosity carry equal weight.
* 1–3 years of field, local, retail, or multi-unit marketing experience is a plus. Coordinators and specialists ready to step up to their first manager role are encouraged to apply.

* Experience in a multi-unit, high-growth environment preferred. Car wash, QSR, or retail operations experience is a bonus.
* Energy and people skills: an outgoing people person who can talk to anyone, from site teammates to school principals and business owners, and brings the energy great field marketing runs on.
* Problem solver and self-starter: a thinker, not just a doer; sees what needs to happen, makes the call, and brings solutions forward rather than waiting for

* Work with Leasing and Asset Management to coordinate marketing, lease-up, resident eligibility, and documentation needed for tax credit delivery.
* Track reporting and compliance deadlines associated with HUD, IHDA, investors, grants, and other funding sources.
* Participate in meetings about development projects and funding opportunities and serve on procurement evaluation committees, as assigned.
* Monitor grant-funded projects to ensure activities align with the approved budget, scope of work and timeline.
* Follow Authority policies and perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in real estate, finance, economics, public administration, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Familiarity with affordable housing financing and programs, including Low-Income Housing Tax Credits and RAD.

* Ability to organize detailed applications and records, track multiple deadlines, and prepare clear and accurate reports.

Work is primarily performed in an office setting, with occasional visits to Authority properties, construction sites, and external meetings. jobs.title: Research Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**Department**

BSD OBG - Lindau Lab - Operations

**About the Department**

The Lindau Laboratory at The University of Chicago is an interdisciplinary, team-based laboratory performing human-level observational, interventional, and health services research motivated by a fundamental concern for the principle of justice in health and health care. The lab, funded predominantly by agencies of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services for more than 15 years, employs about 20 full and part-time researchers and staff across disciplines including epidemiology, gerontology, anthropology, neurobiology, cancer biology, public health, and data science. The lab routinely collaborates across disciplines, departments, and with investigators at other institutions including experts in the fields of computer science, geriatrics, oncology, public health, social services administration, psychology, neuroscience, materials science, engineering and other medical and social science fields. The work of the lab focuses in two main areas: 1) preservation and treatment of female sexual function in the context of aging, cancer and other common diseases and 2) social determinants of health, with a particular concern for women and older adults living in socioeconomically marginalized communities. Our research and programmatic activities include Bionic Breast, WomanLab, Feed1st and CommunityRx. The Lab has spun out two companies: Now Pow, LLC (acquired by Unite USA, Inc. in 2021) and MAPSCorps, 501c3 (joined Northwestern University School of Education and Social Policy in 2023), both originally headquartered in Hyde Park, Chicago, IL.

**Job Summary**

Reporting to the Director of Operations, this position supports the full range of Lindau Lab research operations and provides direct executive support to the Principal Investigator. Operational scope includes research participant and collaborator onboarding, human subjects compensation, procurement and contracts, human resources activities and SOP development, IT and facilities coordination, grant and funding opportunity support, financial and budget assistance, symposium and event coordination, and management of web and digital content for research dissemination. Executive support encompasses calendar management, maintenance of the PI’s biosketch and CV, conference and travel logistics, scientific presentation preparation, and research with Dr. Lindau and others in the lab on assigned special and other research projects.  
  
This at-will position is wholly or partially funded by contractual grant funding which is renewed under provisions set by the grantor of the contract. Employment will be contingent upon the continued receipt of these grant funds and satisfactory job performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Supports the Director of Operations across all aspects of lab research operations.
* Coordinates operational components of lab’s research projects, including but not limited to, research participant onboarding, human subjects compensation, research collaborator onboarding, procurement and contracts.
* Independently conducts human resources activities, including lab member onboarding and offboarding, and SOP development and update.
* Serves as a primary point of contact for lab IT and assists with other general operational needs including space, supplies, equipment and maintenance.
* Identifies, adapts and assists with implementation of AI tools, novel research operations methods and workflows across diverse study settings.
* Supports funding opportunity identification and analysis and the operational components of grant application and submission.
* Participates in the planning and coordination of the annual research symposium for the Bionic Breast Project and supports additional lab events and activities.
* Assists the Director of Operations, as needed, with lab financial management, grant budget development, operational coordination with subaward institutions, and other pre- and post-award grant administrative activities.
* Contributes to research dissemination activities through supporting the maintenance of the Lindau Lab website and other digital platforms.
* Provides direct support to the Principal Investigator to advance daily operational and research priorities. Liaises closely with Dr. Lindau's executive administrator in the university's Office of Research Management.
* Manages the PI’s calendar, biosketch, CV and related professional documentation.
* Coordinates meeting scheduling, conference attendance and itinerary preparation.
* Conducts literature search and synthesis for Dr. Lindau and supports special projects assigned by the PI and prepares and formats presentation materials.
* Support all activities of the Lindau Lab as needed to achieve success.
* Maintains technical and administrative support for a research project.

Verbum Dei Jesuit High School seeks a creative, organized Marketing and Communications Coordinator to share the school’s story, strengthen its visibility, and engage students, families, alumni, donors, corporate partners, and prospective families.

Reporting to the Vice President of Mission Advancement, the Coordinator maintains the school’s brand and coordinates marketing and communications across digital and print platforms. This role works closely with Mission Advancement, Admissions, Athletics, and the Corporate Work Study Program to deliver timely, engaging communications that reflect Verbum Dei’s Catholic, Jesuit mission.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain consistent branding and design print and digital materials, including brochures, invitations, presentations, signage, and advertisements.
* Manage social media platforms, develop content calendars, create photo and video content, and execute campaigns to increase awareness and engagement.
* Write, edit, and coordinate newsletters, email campaigns, press releases, announcements, and other school communications; support annual reports, impact reports, and institutional publications.
* Maintain an editorial calendar, gather content across departments, and coordinate publication schedules to ensure accuracy and timely delivery.
* Manage Mailchimp or comparable email platforms, including formatting, audience segmentation, distribution, and performance tracking.
* Update website content and digital displays, coordinate photography and videography, maintain organized digital assets, and support media relations.
* Develop campaigns, marketing materials, and impact stories supporting fundraising, student recruitment, and corporate partnerships.
* Promote school events, coordinate related media coverage and vendors, track marketing performance, and perform other related duties as assigned.

This full-time, 12-month position is based on campus. Occasional evening and weekend hours are required for school events, athletics, fundraising, and community engagement. Some off-campus work may be required for corporate partner visits, media coverage, and special events.

Benefits include health insurance, retirement benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities, consistent with school policies.

Interested candidates should submit a resume, cover letter, and portfolio or relevant work samples demonstrating skills in writing, graphic design, photography, video production, and social media content creation.

Please email application materials to:

sandrade@verbjesuit.org

----------------

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based company building the world's only mass-produced, transportable nuclear microreactors. The U.S. grid is under growing strain, with power demand accelerating, driving higher utility costs, rising carbon emissions, and interconnection backlogs. Radiant has a solution, transportable, on-site power. Our first reactor, Kaleidos, is 1 megawatt: small enough to be factory-built, transported by land, sea, or air, and deployed wherever power is needed. 1 MW can power 1000 homes for five years. We made energy a product that can be used for critical infrastructure like military bases, data centers, hospitals, and remote sites, as well as the commercial main street businesses that keep America running. Description:

Total Warehouse is seeking a highly analytical Sales Operations Administrator to strengthen the connection between Sales activity, customer intelligence, data quality, and operational execution.

This is not a traditional administrative or data-entry position. The role combines Sales Operations, CRM/ERP administration, KPI analysis, process auditing, commercial intelligence, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will evaluate whether work was completed correctly, determine what the information tells us, identify missing information and root causes, connect customer intelligence to business opportunities, drive corrective action, and help prevent recurring defects.

The position functions as the front-end quality and analytical layer in the Sales ? Sales Admin ? Sales Support/Execution ? Operations ? Customer Follow-Up operating model.

### **Core Responsibilities**

**Sales KPI and Data Analysis**

* Analyze Sales KPIs beyond activity counts to determine quality, accuracy, commercial value, and conversion.
* Review customer assets created, site visits, opportunities, quotes, follow-up activity, pipeline movement, account activity, and expected-close dates.
* Identify trends, outliers, exceptions, recurring defects, and missing information.
* Provide concise, exception-based reporting to Sales Leadership.
* Move measures from activity and count to quality, insight, and commercial outcomes.

**Customer Asset and Account Intelligence**

* Audit customer asset information, including make/model, serial number, location, application, condition, age/hours when available, power requirements, provider, lease/rental status, and service history.
* Identify potential growth opportunities across equipment, Rental, Service/PM, Parts, batteries/chargers, telematics, Allied/racking, and automation.
* Validate that meaningful findings become opportunities, customer discussions, or dated next actions rather than disconnected records.

**NetSuite/CRM Data Integrity**

* Audit Customer Cards, settings, contacts, parent/child relationships, assets, site visits, opportunities, quotes, tasks/events, follow-up dates, and expected-close dates.
* Identify incomplete, duplicate, stale, or incorrectly structured records.
* Route deficiencies to the appropriate owner with a required correction and due date.
* Re-audit completion and escalate repeated or material exceptions.

**Opportunity, Pipeline, and Quote Quality**

* Audit opportunities for customer challenge, application, solution, value, stage, timing, decision process, risks, next action, and follow-up date.
* Differentiate pipeline volume from qualified pipeline quality.
* Review quotes for the correct account, application, product/equipment, configuration, specifications, pricing basis, assumptions, support documentation, customer-value explanation, and follow-up plan.
* Validate critical information before work moves to downstream Operational Sales Support.

**Site Visit and Customer Intelligence**

* Audit site visits for objective, participants, customer challenges, fleet/assets, application, photos, measurements when applicable, identified opportunities, commitments, and next actions.
* Ensure each site visit produces useful customer intelligence and commercial follow-through, not just completion of an activity KPI.

**Continuous Improvement and Root-Cause Analysis**

* Apply practical Lean/DMAIC thinking: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, and Control.
* Categorize recurring defects across training/knowledge, process, system/tool, data quality, and ownership/accountability.
* Help convert recurring problems into improved SOPs, training, workflows, controls, and system improvements.

* Strong organization, prioritization, and evidence-based follow-through.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

The Auction Transaction Coordinator supports the accurate and timely processing of real estate auction transactions. This role manages the deal lifecycle from pre-listing through closing, including document preparation, escrow coordination, CRM data management, and pipeline administration. The position reports to the Director of Operations, Auction Services and works closely with the auction team, advisors, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless deal execution.  
  
The base hourly range for this role is $30.00 – $36.02 per hour. Actual pay will be determined by factors such as education, experience, and job-related skills relevant to the role. Marcus & Millichap is a multi-state employer and posted salary ranges are provided in good faith for compliance with all relevant pay-transparency regulations. These ranges may not reflect potential compensation for positions based in other states or regions.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Transaction & Document Management**

* Manage the full auction deal lifecycle from pre-listing through closing, utilizing Salesforce and Marcus & Millichap's internal transaction platform MNET
* Own, organize, and maintain each individual transaction deal folder, including legal documents, reports, photos, and marketing materials
* Prepare and onboard internal listing documents in compliance with company and state guidelines
* Prepare, send, and track agreement documents through DocuSign
* Track critical transaction dates and ensure all parties meet contractual deadlines
* Collect, organize, and maintain due diligence materials
* Coordinate legal agreements with Marcus & Millichap advisors/agents ensuring compliance across multiple jurisdictions
* Troubleshoot and resolve transactional issues throughout the deal process

**Escrow & Closing**

* Initiate title and escrow orders; track commitments and coordinate with title companies
* Coordinate with auction platforms to receive and process purchase agreements
* Manage post-auction escrow workflows, including wiring instructions and earnest money tracking
* Monitor escrow timelines and transaction records
* Process commission demands
* Submit final closing packages internally with all required documentation

**CRM & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate CRM records including contacts, properties, opportunities, and key deal dates
* Manage the MNET Pipeline and ensure transaction data integrity throughout the deal lifecycle
* Track photography orders, title, and third-party vendor requests
* Record timelines to ensure all parties remain in compliance with contract terms
* Set up and maintain organized deal folders in OneDrive and Outlook

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* 2 to 3 years of experience in transaction coordination, administrative support, or operations, preferably in commercial real estate
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion
* High school diploma required; associate degree preferred

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Salesforce CRM
* Familiarity with real estate closing documents, title commitments, and escrow processes
* Knowledge of auction transactions and multi-state compliance requirements
* Familiarity with tools such as Asana and DocuSign

**Ideal Candidate:**

* Highly organized and process-driven
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment
* Able to problem-solve and adapt as transaction needs evolve
* Professional, responsive, and collaborative in working with internal and external stakeholders
* Committed to accuracy, follow-through, and delivering a high level of support

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative**

**Reports to:** Regional Business Development Director

**Location:** Irvine, California

**Employment type:** Full-time, Exempt

**Bonus Opportunity:** This position is qualified for the discretionary bonus program.

**About Saarman Construction**

At Saarman Construction, you'll help to give existing buildings a second chance to age with grace. From apartments and condominiums to homes and commercial spaces, we reconstruct and revitalize aging buildings while residents and tenants stay in place, with building envelope and waterproofing repairs, seismic retrofitting, and ongoing maintenance that keep them strong for years to come. Environmental stewardship is part of how we work, from recycling and reusing materials to growing our hybrid and electric fleet.

**Position Summary**

Under the general supervision of the Regional Business Development Director, the Business Development Representative identifies, develops, and supports new business opportunities for Saarman. This role prospects and qualifies leads, builds relationships with property owners, managers, and industry partners, and keeps a strong, consistent pipeline of projects flowing to the estimating and operations teams. The position requires regular field travel to properties, client meetings, and industry events. The schedule offers some work-from-home flexibility, with required in-office team meetings.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and research potential clients, properties, and projects within Saarman’s target markets: HOA, affordable and market-rate multifamily, senior living, and hospitality
* Conduct outbound outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, and in-person networking
* Build and maintain relationships with HOA boards and community managers, property management companies, apartment owners and asset managers, REITs, affordable housing operators, building envelope consultants, reserve study firms, and construction defect attorneys
* Qualify leads and schedule introductory meetings and site walks for the business development and estimating teams
* Attend site walks and pre-bid walks to understand project scope and client needs
* Monitor bid platforms, RFPs, and upcoming projects, and help assemble Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) and proposal packages
* Present Saarman’s capabilities to HOA boards, ownership groups, and property management teams
* Follow up on submitted bids and proposals to keep opportunities moving toward award
* Track all activities, leads, and opportunities in the CRM and keep pipeline data current
* Collaborate with marketing, estimating, and operations to align messaging, offerings, and client hand-offs
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Saarman’s services, market trends, and competitors

  

**Trade Shows and Events**

* Help choose which trade shows, association events, and networking meetings to attend, based on target clients and markets
* Before each event: review attendee and exhibitor lists, identify target contacts, and set meetings in advance
* Coordinate with the Marketing Representative on booth materials, giveaways, and collateral (Marketing manages registrations and logistics)
* Staff the booth and attend sessions, mixers, and client dinners, representing Saarman professionally
* Capture leads and contact information at every event and enter them in the CRM within 48 hours
* Follow up with every new contact within one week and turn event conversations into meetings and site walks
* Help plan and host Saarman client events, lunch-and-learns, and community manager education sessions

  

**Travel:** Regular local field travels; occasional overnight travel within California and Hawaii.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales, or account management (construction, property management, or related industry preferred)
* Excellent verbal and written communication and relationship-building skills
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong time management and the ability to handle multiple opportunities at once
* Self-directed with a high level of initiative, and able to work successfully within a team
* Basic understanding of construction services or bidding processes
* Experience using a CRM system
* Committed to delivering outstanding customer service and quality work
* Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and proof of auto insurance

  

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with HOAs, community management, or multifamily property management; CAI involvement a plus
* Knowledge of exterior repair, waterproofing, or construction defect work

  

**Work Environment**

* Hybrid schedule with work-from-home flexibility and required in-office team meetings
* Regular field travel to properties, job sites, client offices, and industry events, including some evening HOA board meetings and events
* Occasional overnight travel within California and Hawaii

Job Description:

At IPS, we are global leaders in developing innovative solutions for the consulting, architecture, engineering, project controls, procurement, construction management, and CQV of technically complex facilities, primarily in the life sciences industry. We are looking for a talented **Design Project Coordinator** to join our dedicated team at our office in **Emeryville, California**.

In this role, you will provide administrative and project support to Project Managers and project teams to ensure the smooth execution of design-related activities. This role focuses on organizing project documentation, providing project management support, coordinating team deliverables, and facilitating communication between project participants. The position may include limited task management responsibilities and requires familiarity with project workflows, documentation standards, basic technical understanding, and project management principles. This role offers exposure to project management practices and technical coordination and is a development opportunity for early-career engineering professionals interested in transitioning to a Project Management track.

* Familiarity with engineering or architectural terminology.
* Ability to read and interpret basic project documentation (drawings, specifications).
* Strong analytical and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in all aspects of work.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Enthusiastic and proactive approach to learning and supporting goals.

Travel

* Please review the IPS Travel Policy.

* Must have access to reliable transportation.
* Must have the ability to travel and commute on a daily or routine basis.

* This position is a safety-sensitive position.
* The employee may be required to work in the field and attend activities at client sites where they work in construction, process, packaging, manufacturing, research or other "non-administrative" areas.

About Us:

Integration is how we think and work. It requires the ability to unite existing and emerging technologies into a process that reliably delivers products and accelerates speed to market. That end-to-end mindset allows us to be agile and anticipate challenges as we move projects toward operational readiness. IPS applies design and delivery expertise, client-side experience, and supplier-side insight to every project. We infuse our curiosity, our passion, and our commitment to partnership in delivering solutions at any scale. We meet our clients where they are and get them to where they need to go. That’s only possible when we care as much as our clients do.

Process Architecture, Process Design, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Qualification, LEAN Project Delivery, Strategic Master Planning, Energy Conservation Management, Project Controls, Program/Project Management, Operations/Logistics Strategy and Planning, EPC

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
  
  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution.
  
  
More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT and many more.
  
  
Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.
  
  
The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

new_jobs.title: Field Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Field Business Development Representative**

**Position Overview**

Farahi Law Firm is an award-winning personal injury firm dedicated to fighting for the injured and delivering exceptional legal representation. We are a fast-growing, client-centric team that values aggressive advocacy, innovation, and community impact. At Farahi Law Firm, every referral represents someone whose life has been impacted by an accident. As a Field Representative, you serve as the firm's ambassador in the community, developing meaningful relationships with automotive body shops and positioning Farahi Law Firm as their trusted partner for personal injury cases. This is a highly relationship-driven role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, meeting new people, and building long-term partnerships — success comes from creating genuine connections, not making sales pitches. The Field Business Development Representative is responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with body shop owners, managers, and staff, spending the majority of the workday visiting partner locations to strengthen existing relationships, identify new opportunities, and ensure Farahi Law Firm remains a trusted referral resource. This role works in close partnership with an assigned Business Development Representative (BDR), who supports outreach through phone, email, text, and follow-up communications, executing a coordinated relationship-building strategy designed to maximize engagement and referral growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute daily field visits to assigned body shops throughout the Sta Clara, CA.
* Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with shop owners, managers, estimators, and front-office staff.
* Represent Farahi Law Firm with professionalism, integrity, and exceptional customer service.
* Plan efficient daily routes to maximize productivity and territory coverage.
* Partner closely with the assigned Business Development Representative to coordinate outreach strategies and follow-up activities.
* Document customer interactions, relationship updates, and visit outcomes within the company's CRM.
* Identify high-potential business opportunities and communicate recommendations to leadership.
* Maintain consistent communication with internal stakeholders regarding account status and next steps.
* Act as a trusted brand ambassador within the local automotive repair community.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Valid driver's license with a reliable personal vehicle.
* Willingness to travel extensively throughout the Los Angeles area as part of daily responsibilities.
* Comfortable working within automotive repair and collision center environments.
* Strong verbal communication and relationship-building skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in outside sales.
* Experience in business development.
* Experience in community outreach.
* Experience in brand ambassador roles.
* Experience in account management.
* Experience in customer relationship management.
* Experience working in the automotive, insurance, or legal industries is a plus.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is an outgoing, self-motivated professional who enjoys building authentic relationships and spending the majority of their day in the field. They are proactive, organized, and understand that trust is built through consistency, professionalism, and genuine human connection. Successful candidates are:

* Naturally personable with outstanding interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable initiating conversations and developing long-term business relationships.
* Highly organized with strong territory and time management skills.
* Self-directed and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, valuing partnership and shared success.
* Adaptable, resilient, and motivated by achieving measurable business results.

**Success in This Role**

You will be successful if you:

* Build trusted, long-lasting relationships with assigned accounts.
* Consistently expand referral opportunities within your territory.
* Collaborate effectively with your Business Development Representative partner.
* Maintain accurate CRM documentation and activity tracking.
* Represent the firm's mission and values with professionalism in every interaction.

**Reporting Structure**

This position reports directly to the Business Development Manager and works in close partnership with an assigned Business Development Representative. Performance is evaluated based on both individual contribution and team collaboration.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive base salary.
* Performance-based commission.
* Mileage reimbursement.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Supportive, collaborative team environment.

**This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who**

* Enjoys working outside of a traditional office environment.
* Enjoys meeting new people every day.
* Builds trust naturally and values long-term relationships.
* Is energized by being in the community rather than behind a desk.
* Wants to make a meaningful impact while contributing to the growth of a mission-driven organization.

new_jobs.title: Accounting Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Treasure AI:**

Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers. Powered by AI, Treasure AI is shaped by human creativity and always-on through continuous, context-driven action.

Furthermore, Treasure AI employees are enthusiastic, data-driven, and customer-obsessed. We are a team of drivers—self-starters who take initiative, anticipate needs, and proactively jump in to solve problems. Our actions reflect our values of honesty, reliability, openness, and humility.

**Your Role:**  
Under the direction of the CAO, this role plays a key operational role in the procurement and accounting operations. This individual will perform tasks as assigned and remain flexible in regards to the team’s needs. This position provides growth opportunities to expand the role based on the individual’s ability to learn quickly, and complete the assigned responsibilities timely and accurately. Additional initiative to identify, propose, and execute process improvements will determine the rate of progression.

The ideal candidate should have demonstrated experience working in a fast-paced and ever changing environment, preferably in the technology industry. Additionally, they will bring exceptional organizational and communication skills, keen attention to detail, and a thirst for knowledge.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage front-end global Zip procurement workflows, ensuring all purchase requests are triaged, routed, and processed accurately and within defined SLAs
* Responsible for review of all purchase requests to be in compliance with current policies and make recommendations if needed.
* Own and manage and update the vendor master file, ensuring supplier records are accurate, complete, and up to date.
* Assist procurement in ongoing Zip projects
* Assist or may be responsible for customer billing, and/or collections process, and/or responding to customer inquiry
* Assist in month end reconciliations and/or generation of AR/customer reports
* Assist in various general ledger monthly reconciliations
* Assist or may be responsible for T&E and expense reimbursement process, which may include reviewing, following up with stakeholders, reconciliation, new systems testing, and reporting
* Assist the accounting and finance team on various AI and/or process improvement projects
* Identify repetitive, rule-based tasks and design scalable workflows using AI tools to improve processing efficiency
* Utilize AI tools to improve efficiencies; includes building skills and agents within Treasure Work
* Collaborate and manage relationships with internal stakeholders, including Finance & Accounting, FP&A, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business leaders
* Complete other ad hoc projects, as assigned

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field
* 2 years of experience in accounting and/or procurement, or a related field
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently, cross functionally, and as part of a team
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient in MS Office and/or G Suite
* Motivated with a proactive mindset
* Working knowledge of Zip or similar procurement system preferred
* Working knowledge of Workday or similar ERP system preferred
* Comfort using AI-powered tools (such as Treasure Work, AI sourcing/matching platforms, and recruiting analytics) as part of day-to-day procurement workflows and processes

**Physical Requirements:**

Working out of the Mountain View, California office according to our “Global Hybrid Working Policy.”

**Travel Requirements:**

May require travel annually as needed for the team offsite.  
  
**Perks and Benefits (US):**

Our benefit package showcases our culture of care and empathy with

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision plans and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Competitive compensation packages
* Company paid life insurance 3x salary
* Company paid short- and long-term disability coverage
* Retirement planning (401K) with 4% company match
* Restricted Stock Units (RSU)
* Flexible Time Off (FTO)
* Up to 26 weeks paid parental leave including a post-partum night nurse
* Comprehensive support and access to care for everyone, everywhere through Carrot - our global reproductive health and family-building benefit.

**Our Dedication to You:**

We value and promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our business and at all levels. Success comes from acknowledging, welcoming, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Diverse representation alone is not the desired outcome. We also strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages growth, ownership of your role, and achieving innovation in new and unique ways. Your voice will be heard, and we will help amplify it.

**Agencies and Recruiters:**

We cannot consider your candidate(s) without a contract in place. Any resumes received without having an active agreement will be considered gratis referrals to us. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

This description captures the core of the role today. As we adopt AI and new ways of working, responsibilities may evolve, and we encourage team members to take initiative, lean into change, and help expand the impact of their role beyond what’s listed here.

new_jobs.description:
We're looking for someone who lives and breathes the internet. Someone who knows what's happening on X before it becomes a headline, understands the nuances of different online communities, tracks the latest platform updates, and instinctively knows when a conversation is worth joining.The ideal candidate is equal parts chronically online, analytically minded, and highly organized. They have impeccable taste, sharp editorial judgment, a strong instinct for compelling social content, and a deep understanding of how influential voices build and engage audiences online. They understand internet culture and humor, know what makes a great meme (and can make one themselves), and can spot emerging trends before they go mainstream. They are naturally curious, closely follow developments in AI, technology, and other fast-moving industries, and understand how to translate complex ideas into content that feels timely, relevant, and culturally resonant.This role will sit within Meta's Executive Communications team, supporting the community engagement of a C-suite executive's social presence across Instagram, Facebook, Threads, and X.This person will play an important role in shaping how a senior executive shows up online, helping our team identify opportunities to participate in relevant conversations, deepen relationships with key communities, and continuously improve our social strategy.We're looking for someone who understands that effective social media is about more than publishing content. It's about understanding audiences, knowing how to read the room, recognizing emerging conversations, and creating meaningful engagement.The right person will be highly detail-oriented, proactive, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of exercising sound judgment in a fast-moving, high-visibility environment.

* Community management and engagement: Monitor comments, replies, mentions, and relevant conversations across platforms to identify opportunities for the executive to engage with individuals, creators, and communities
